subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Should Feishu conversation binding use explicit peer syntax, channel-specific Feishu ID inference, or this PR's account-escape grammar for the existing `--bind <channel>:<account>` CLI contract?
rationale: The routing bug is real, but the submitted fix changes a documented CLI grammar that writes persisted config and there are multiple open candidate PRs with different compatibility tradeoffs.

options.title: Preserve Account Syntax And Add Peer Syntax
options.body: Keep `feishu:<account>` as account binding and add a documented peer form such as `feishu:group:<id>` or another explicit conversation syntax.

options.title: Infer Feishu Conversation IDs Safely
options.body: Allow known Feishu conversation-id prefixes to become peers while preserving unrecognized account names as account bindings and documenting the heuristic.

options.title: Pause This Branch And Pick A Candidate
options.body: Pause or close this PR if another open candidate better preserves compatibility and can supply stronger proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve Account Syntax And Add Peer Syntax
recommendation.body: Keep `feishu:<account>` as account binding and add a documented peer form such as `feishu:group:<id>` or another explicit conversation syntax.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent routing/docs history around the public CLI and route semantics that need the compatibility decision.
